images.title: Decode and draw a ring
images.purpose: Give practice reading rings: a colour key, two finished rings, and one empty ring for the student to colour.
images.composition: A small colour key at the left and three rings in a row to its right, the last one empty and dashed, plenty of space.
exact_structure: Colour key at left, stacked: a teal #0072B2 dot with 2, an amber #E69F00 dot with 3, a green #009E73 dot with 5.
Ring around 8: exactly 3 equal teal arcs.
Ring around 10: exactly 2 equal arcs, one teal and one green.
Ring around 15: a grey #6B7280 dashed ring split into exactly 2 equal uncoloured arcs, with a reddish purple #CC79A7 ? beside it.
rejection: the 8 ring not having exactly 3 teal arcs
the 10 ring coloured other than one teal and one green arc
any of the numbers 101 to 110 shown
images.takeaway: Read the colours to find the primes, and split a ring into one arc per prime to draw a new one.
images.description: A key of 2 teal, 3 amber, 5 green, rings for 8 (three teal arcs) and 10 (teal and green), and an empty dashed ring for 15 with a question mark.
images.context: Shown beside the practice on decoding the rings.
images.teaching_notes: Ask what colours the two arcs of the 15 ring should be before moving on to 101 to 110.

image_decisions.why: An empty ring next to finished ones invites the student to apply the rule.
